items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; chat-tab version follows Nov 23
items.summary_en: Per search-result snippets of OpenAI's model release notes, GPT-6.2 Astra (positioned as a frontier model for complex work) and Sol (reasoning with speed and efficiency) launched Nov 17 in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. A GPT-6.2 version optimized for the chat tab reportedly followed on Nov 23 for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users.
items.source_name: OpenAI Help Center - Model Release Notes
items.notes: openai.com was unreachable (DNS blocked) so the page was not read directly. Details come from a WebSearch summary of the page. The Nov 17 launch is just before the window; the Nov 23 chat-tab rollout is inside it. Dates are as printed on the page per the search tool and were not independently verified.

items.title: ChatGPT Space rolls out to Plus users
items.summary_en: According to search-result snippets of OpenAI's ChatGPT release notes, ChatGPT Space, a feature for creating interactive pages and presentations with ChatGPT, rolled out to Plus users on Nov 20.

items.title: Businesses in ChatGPT beta expands eligibility to non-US ecommerce and online service businesses
items.summary_en: Businesses in ChatGPT is a beta Business Hub where companies claim a listing and interact with users through Business Agents. Per search snippets, a Nov 19 update made ecommerce and online service businesses based outside the U.S. eligible to claim listings.
items.notes: Original post dated Nov 10 per the search summary. The Nov 19 date refers to the update. Page not read directly.

items.title: Healthcare model configurations arrive in the OpenAI API
items.summary_en: Per a search summary of OpenAI's release notes, healthcare model configurations became available in the API on Nov 24. No further detail was retrievable.
